inputs.source_text: A short news article to summarize.
inputs.condition_api: prompt-conditioned runs may pass --prompt/--source_text when the bundle includes elf_text_encoder_plan; replay runs may instead provide condition_latents_raw/condition_latents_path and condition_mask_raw/condition_mask_path
inputs.output_schema: jsonl lines with id, generated, and token_ids

metadata.expected_report: Conditional ELF evaluation reports generated summaries and ROUGE/BLEU-style task metrics when online evaluation is enabled.
metadata.notes: Replays tensors exported from the official ELF JAX evaluator for the checked-in source article and requires exact normalized text plus token-id parity under the original ODE64 configuration. Decoder blocks 0-4 and the final boundary run in FP16 with FP32 GEMM accumulation. Blocks 5-11 remain FP32 because casting the growing flow activations back to FP16 overflows before block 6.
